name: SVC_STD_TXT_USR_VARS_INT
description: This table stores the available variables defined by the customer and its static values or object.attribute substitution.

columns.name: VARIABLE_ID
columns.description: variable_id is resolved during the enrichment process.

columns.name: VARIABLE_NUMBER
columns.description: Variable_Number. This is a public surrogate key.

columns.name: VARIABLE_UNIQUE_NUMBER
columns.description: Variable_Number. This is a public surrogate key and is a required field in the base table.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: Variable that is displayed in the UI for context substitution into actual value.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Short Description of the variable and its context.

columns.name: CONTEXT
columns.description: Indicator of the application or context this variable is used.

columns.name: OBJECT
columns.description: This is the reference to the object that holds the value for substituting the variable.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: This is the field or attribute on the object that holds the value for substitution

columns.name: VAL_CHAR
columns.description: Static character value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: VAL_DATE
columns.description: Static date value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: VAL_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: Static timestamp value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: VAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Static number value for the variable substitution.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on ourcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record begin updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is required to track multi csv import of standard text folder objects.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely .

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: DATACONTROL
columns.description: This is the reference to the datacontrol that the object belongs to .

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.
